items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 5:1
items.html: The upper aspect of the stature of the Mochin is called Keter, and it depends on the lower aspect of the coarseness of the vessels, which is the screen, in such a way that if two degrees have the measure of a single MAN, their Keter is also one, as stated in the previous parts. And it is known that the growth of the Nukva throughout the whole back of ZA up to his Keter, which was on the fourth day of the work of creation, was made by the inclusion of the Hod of AA in his Netzach, by which the Nukva received the measure of the Nukva of the body of ZA, and she became the aspect of Malchut of Netzach like him, as above in Answer 6, see there. Therefore the Nukva became fit to use those male MAN of ZA, like the Nukva in the body of ZA; hence she was able to receive the Binot and Gevurot of the Aba and Ima of the AB of the Mazal, like him, which are in an equal stature with the Hochma and Hassadim of the Aba and Ima of the AB of the Mazal. In this she is found with ZA in a single Keter indeed, for since their MAN are a single aspect, namely the Malchut of Netzach, which is the aspect of the male MAN drawn from the Mazal VeNotzer, it is inevitable that their Keter is also one, namely the upper aspect of the Mochin, which is the height of the Mochin, as above. And this is what the Nukva argued: it is impossible that two kings use a single Keter, as above in Answer 6, see there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 5:2
items.html: (To the question) And know that this measure of a single Keter operates constantly in Aba and Ima, and this is the secret of they emerge together and abide together. And this is because they are always in the aspect of a single MAN: if permanently, they are both in the aspect of the MAN of the coarseness of Behina Bet; and if in the aspect of AB, they are both in the aspect of the MAN of the Mazalot, which is the male MAN that serves for both of them. Therefore they are always in a single Keter, for at the time that they have the measure of a single MAN, they also necessarily have a single Keter, as above. And remember this. And what is said in Section 63, that his Keter is higher than her Keter, is because, in the aspect of Aba, he is discerned as though he did not emerge from the head of AA, as above, 141. (Item 5).
